## 3. Runs 1–3 — the earlier stops, and the 'before' of Amendment 3

Run 1 (`a3f6a9c`) stopped at T2 on the original row 4: τ_exact − v1 proxy outside [−1, 61] s on 2,774 of 15,763 (17.6%). Its T1 took the largest-size {8, 15} print. Its artifacts are kept under `artifacts/run1/`. Amendment 1 re-specified T1 (A1.2) and row 4 (A1.1).

Run 2 (`518152c`) cleared rows 1 and 4, ran T3-T6 on the bipower instrument, and stopped at T6 on row 2: failed negative_excursion, positive_excursion, blindness. Its T4-T6 artifacts and charts are kept under `artifacts/run2/` and `charts/run2/` as the record of what the bipower instrument produced (A2.10); its A2 ladder, which stopped at the first failing rung, gave zero valid rungs on 27 of 49 dev events. Amendment 2 changed the noise scale to realised variance (A2.1), derived the control references by simulation (A2.2), added the peak tie rule (A2.3), judged every A2 rung on its own (A2.4), left the W ≥ L competition cells undefined (A2.5) and re-derived the halt flag (A2.6); T1-T3 were not re-run.

Run 3 (`99b7e51`, Amendment 2) passed all 7 T6 controls and stopped at T7. Amendment 3 anchored the A2 ladder at the start of τ's clock segment (A3.1), made τ inside a cross minute a class with no A2 (A3.2), retired DA-4 and `open_adjacent_0930` (A3.3), and matched the T5b control on the octave since i's own crossing and the clock segment (A3.5). Run 3's T5, T5b and T6 artifacts and charts are kept under `artifacts/run3/` and `charts/run3/` as the 'before'. **T4 below is run 3's (T4 does not re-run, A3.7); T5, T5b and T6 are the Amendment 3 run.**

## 10. T5b — competition check (dev-event dates only)

49 dates; crossings with at least one live name 750. Control (Amendment 3 A3.5): for each (live name i, crossing j) pair and window W, control moments t are drawn from i's own live span with (a) the same octave of time since i's own crossing as tau_j: floor(log2(t - tau_i in seconds)) == floor(log2(tau_j - tau_i in seconds)); (b) the same clock segment as tau_j (premarket / regular / after hours; auction minutes are their own segments); (c) no other D1 crossing within +/- W; (d) t - W >= 04:00 and t + W <= 20:00. Drawn uniformly on a 1-second grid, controls_per_pair per pair, with the config seed (A3.5).

## 13. Recorded, not acted on (A1.8)

Every earlier `move_at` (R0-T0c, v0, v1, v2, the exit overlay) used the minute-bar prior close, which differs from the revised close by a median of 36.2 bp (p95 372.6 bp) on this run. Those results are not re-run; their +30% membership and `move_at` carry this basis difference, whose direction on their findings has not been assessed.
